[media]
# **The Legend Begins...**
A ruthless master rises. Vengeful emperors scheme. Peasants sharpen their blades. They all have something to prove—and only one path forward: **Kung Fu.**

[media]
# **Step Into Your Own Kung Fu Movie**
You’re not watching a Kung Fu movie—you’re in it. Dragon Fist delivers fast-paced melee combat powered by physics and real martial arts.

[media]
# **Hone in Your Skills**
Practice strikes, blocks, dodges, and combos. There is an endless amount of combat to explore.

[media]
# **Play Your Way**
- Campaign
- Multiplayer (up to 8)
- Co-op Campaign
- Training
- and More...

=========================

# New Fighter Forge Expansion Pack: Western Warriors

Show off your wild style in Fighter Forge! The Western Warriors expansion pack adds 30 new clothing items and hairstyles for your custom characters, and can be used in both single and multiplayer modes. As with all other items in Fighter Forge, these can be colored to your liking.

The following items are included in the Western Warriors expansion pack:

- **Hairstyles:** Mullets, Mohawks
- **Hats:** Cowboy Hats, Top Hat, Bowler Hat, Bandana
- **Accessories:** MMA Gloves, Eye Patch Monocle, Necklaces, Face Mask, Aviator Sunglasses
- **Pants:** Jeans, USA and Golden Style Karate Pants
- **Shoes:** Cowboy Boots
